senses.gloss: m. (קרטף, Parel of קטף; cmp. קָטָף) incision, scratch, crack.—Pl. קַרְטוּפְנֵי.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 86a:6">B. Kam. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>דאית ליה ק׳ וכ׳</he> if he has sores from scratches on his head &c., v. <cite ref="R00170"><he>צְוַוח</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 107b:14">Keth. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>דלית בהו ק׳</he> when the glazed vessels have no cracks.
<cite ref="Pesachim 30b:7">Pes. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>היכא דאית בהו ק׳</he> when they have cracks, opp. <he>שיעי</he>.
